order: Close out every finding from the prior review round in full. Rewrite the test-authoring seat's mirror-substitution conflict text to match the exception now declared for that seat. That exception is closed by the cross-family exception recorded elsewhere. Verify that the lint check exits clean once the fix lands. Restore the documentation seat's dropped rule that the inert verification tier never applies to documentation. Reinstate that rule at its original plan lines, unchanged from before. Correct the legacy-validation rule-count table for the base and heavy executors. The base carries ten rules, and heavy carries twelve, including two rules unique to heavy. Describe the environment-variable deviation as caught on review rather than self-disclosed. The report's own deviations line already says none. State the cross-vendor engine fault tally as exactly ten of fourteen engine-reaching attempts. Give an explicit counting rule and a full per-attempt list, replacing the earlier wrong figure. Clear the remaining minor findings and nits still open from the prior round.
claims: We fixed all five major findings and six minor findings from the prior round. Every outstanding nit was cleared too, across ten files altogether. The cross-vendor engine fault tally was recomputed as exactly 10 of 14 engine-reaching attempts. That figure came with an explicit counting rule and a full per-attempt list. It replaces the earlier wrong figure of roughly six of fifteen. The rule-count table now reads ten base rules and twelve heavy rules. We checked every entry against the source files, row by row.
